# Map Skills Neighborhood Walk Planner

Subject: Social Studies
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Planning Template
NYS framework label: New York State K-12 Social Studies Framework

## Short Description
A simple planning sheet for using classroom or school maps to name places, symbols, and routes.

## Alignment Note
Supports geographic reasoning, map symbols, location, and community vocabulary.

## Classroom Use Case
Use for an indoor school walk or map center before students create their own maps.

## Preview Content
- Start place
- Map symbol I used
- Route words: near, next to, across from

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
